Status: Wave 296 accepted (6.3): the GroupObjectNumber and StartIndex getters

Method.evidence: Class904 and Class905 both format themselves as GroupObjectNumber={0} StartIndex={1}: Class904 from b(), a() and Class905 from d(), b(), so the formatter call order names each getter without needing the setters - Class904 b() is the group object number and a() the start index, Class905 d() the group object number and b() the start index. Class904 also has the family byte[] factory. The four byte setters stay unresolved because they write through the base helper and their IL carries no offset constant for the reader to pair them with; that needs their helper call read directly.
Method.themes: Formatter call order names a getter even when every offset is hidden behind a base helper. Remaining: Class904/Class905 setters (helper call read), Class834 (getter types), Class938 (formatter prints only a constant), Class871 (four packed 16-bit fields).
